name: What factors determine the cost of professional drywall sanding?

mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of professional drywall sanding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Drywall sanding costs depend on the square footage, ceiling height, whether it is a small patch repair or full-room remodel, and the required finish level. Basic repair patches take less labor, while whole-room installations or full basement finishes require multiple passes across seams, inside corners, and screw heads. Labor rates also account for dust containment setup and surface wipe-down prior to painting. Combining drywall hanging, taping, sanding, and prime painting under a single finish contractor is generally more cost-effective than hiring separate trade specialists for individual repair stages.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on the total wall area, ceiling heights, repair complexity, dust containment needs, and whether sanding is bundled with painting services.
